brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full-hex cell at 0,0,0 with solid top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top) and solid end caps on all 6 side faces (caps at bearings 30/90/150/210/270/330), forming a closed box. Checked build shows no open-face errors and meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre fitted to slot 0 (port:0#0,0#0 / hex-port-louvre) replacing ventilation opening in side cap; part description: vents a closed cell without letting rain in. Provides airflow for enclosed electronics.

finish.summary: Built a single-cell closed enclosure from one full hex base, capped with a solid top cover and solid side caps on all faces via capOpenFaces, then fitted a hex-port-louvre to one port slot to provide breathing/ventilation while remaining enclosed. Build verifies clear with lockJoints not needed.
